text:
Maya Patel (CS): quick sync — StellarPay onboarding kickoff scheduled for Mon 9am PST. I want to lock stakeholders, success criteria, and a 6-week timeline today. @Ravi Shah can you own infra readiness and required creds?

Ravi Shah (Solutions): got it. I'll need S3 access and a list of test datasets from the customer by EOD Thu. I'll spin up a dedicated dev pool on Dedicated for the initial load test.

Tom Bowers (AE): FYI I completed the handoff doc earlier — sent to StellarPay CSMs. Customer PM (Lena) expects a working demo by week 3. I'll re-share the doc in #sales-resources.

Priya Nair (Onboarding): for enablement, propose two sessions: Platform basics (week 1) and Integration deep-dive (week 2). Also schedule an adoption review at week 5. Who should run the integration deep-dive? @Ravi?

onboard-bot: Reminder set: Kickoff meeting Mon 09:00 PST (link: https://zoom.redwood.prod/stellarpay-kickoff). Calendar invites sent to Maya, Tom, Priya.

Maya Patel (CS): success criteria proposal — 1) demo environment up + smoke tests green, 2) latency at or below 250ms p95 for demo traffic, 3) key QA prompts pass (provided by StellarPay), 4) customer trained and has run 3 successful end-to-end flows. Agree?

Ravi Shah (Solutions): agree, but add infra checklist: GPU pool configured, KMS keys exchanged, a test token rotation plan, and logs shipping to their SIEM. I'll post the deploy checklist in thread.

Tom Bowers (AE): add renewal risk note — customer asked about throughput for peak mornings. We should include capacity options in week 4 review (Dedicated vs burst). I'll capture pricing scenarios.

Priya Nair (Onboarding): for feedback capture, we'll run a short survey after session 2 and keep a rolling prompt-eval set. I'll create a shared doc and a tiny Post-Onboard survey (3 Qs).

Maya Patel (CS): timeline (working):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, stakeholder map, creds exchange
- Week 1: demo env + basics training
- Week 2: integration deep-dive + smoke tests
- Week 3: customer demo + initial performance run
- Week 4: capacity/pricing review + quantization / batch tuning suggestions
- Week 5: adoption review + regression checks
- Week 6: handoff to success ops for steady-state

Ravi Shah (Solutions): noted dependencies: S3 + KMS access by Thu, sample prompt set by Fri, test account for SIEM by Mon week1. Risk: if prompts delayed >1 week, demo shifts.

Tom Bowers (AE): I'll chase Lena for the prompt set this afternoon. If I don't hear back, I'll escalate to VP.

Priya Nair (Onboarding): prep checklist (short):
```
- invite links + access verified
- docs + runbook shared
- smoke test script uploaded
- enablement slide deck reviewed
```

Maya Patel (CS): action owners: Ravi -> infra & smoke tests; Priya -> enablement + feedback doc; Tom -> customer prompts & pricing scenarios; Maya -> overall timeline + stakeholder comms. I'll send a status update Friday.

Ravi Shah (Solutions): I'll post the infra checklist by EOD and create the dev pool.

onboard-bot: Task created: "StellarPay onboarding - infra checklist" assigned to Ravi Shah, due 2026-04-03.

Maya Patel (CS): thanks everyone — short prep meeting Fri 4pm PST to confirm prereqs. If anyone cannot make it, drop notes here. :thumbsup:
